description: The proof service at the single guard seam (plan task pod-17, docs/PROOF-SERVICE.md): the categories that are scanned, the records of a run (task_start, tree, call, task_end) and the resumed chain, recovery after a crash, the overlap mark, the scan budget and the switch to checks-only, the end of a run while a call still runs, the Hub data folder inside the workspace (lib/proof/service.mjs), and the seams that call it: HubManager.createAgentSession, #guardCalls and its onProof, finishProof and recoverProof (lib/manager.mjs), the agent's onProof, #finish and load (lib/agent.mjs), BrowserRunner.finish and the side chat's manager (lib/concurrent-api-agent.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-service.mjs.

mutations.name: PS-external-always
mutations.what: every allowed external call is scanned, flagged touchesWorkspace or not

mutations.name: PS-unknown-not-scanned
mutations.what: calls of category unknown are not scanned

mutations.name: PS-budget-at-or-over
mutations.what: a mean of exactly 1,500 ms switches to checks-only

mutations.name: PS-budget-waits-longer
mutations.what: the decision waits for one scan more than minScans

mutations.name: PS-budget-no-switch
mutations.what: the budget is recorded but the granularity stays calls

mutations.name: PS-budget-not-recorded
mutations.what: the switch to checks-only is not recorded in the ledger

mutations.name: PS-full-scan-in-mean
mutations.what: the full snapshot of a run's start counts in the mean

patches.old: const { ref, ms } = await this.#scan({ full: true, signal });
patches.new: const { ref, ms } = await this.#scan({ full: true, signal }); task.scans.push(ms);

mutations.name: PS-start-cached
mutations.what: the snapshot of a run's start is a cached one

patches.old: const { ref, ms } = await this.#scan({ full: true, signal });
patches.new: const { ref, ms } = await this.#scan({ full: false, signal });

mutations.name: PS-end-cached
mutations.what: the final snapshot is a cached one

patches.old: const { ref, ms } = await this.#scan({ full: true });

mutations.name: PS-second-task-start
mutations.what: a resumed run writes task_start again

mutations.name: PS-run-event
mutations.what: every run starts with the event task_start

mutations.name: PS-run-count
mutations.what: the run number is counted wrong

mutations.name: PS-no-recovery-in-begin
mutations.what: begin() does not write what a run that died left out

mutations.name: PS-recover-no-call
mutations.what: recovery does not record the call that was interrupted

mutations.name: PS-recover-finished-call-open
mutations.what: a call with its record counts as interrupted

mutations.name: PS-recover-twice
mutations.what: a call already recorded as interrupted is recorded again

mutations.name: PS-recover-ignores-task-end
mutations.what: a run that ended with task_end counts as interrupted

patches.old: else if (type === 'task_end' || (type === 'uncertain' && record.reason === UNCERTAIN_REASONS.runInterrupted)) run.ended = true;
patches.new: else if (type === 'uncertain' && record.reason === UNCERTAIN_REASONS.runInterrupted) run.ended = true;

mutations.name: PS-recover-ended-runs
mutations.what: runs that ended are recovered too

mutations.name: PS-any-task
mutations.what: a call of another task is recorded in the active task's ledger

mutations.name: PS-halted-scans
mutations.what: a ledger that failed is still scanned for

mutations.name: PS-granularity-ignored
mutations.what: calls are scanned after the switch to checks-only

mutations.name: PS-category-ignored
mutations.what: a call of any category is scanned

mutations.name: PS-overlap-one-side
mutations.what: only the later of two overlapping calls is marked

patches.old: if (peers.size) { token.overlapped = true; for (const peer of peers) peer.overlapped = true; }

mutations.name: PS-overlap-never
mutations.what: overlapping calls are not marked

patches.old: if (peers.size) { token.overlapped = true; for (const peer of peers) peer.overlapped = true; }

mutations.name: PS-in-flight-kept
mutations.what: a finished call stays in flight for its workspace

mutations.name: PS-changed-inverted
mutations.what: changed says the opposite

mutations.name: PS-comparable-always
mutations.what: trees without an id, or of another algorithm, are compared

patches.old: const comparable = (before, after) => Boolean(before?.tree && after?.tree && before.treeAlgorithm === after.treeAlgorithm && before.objectFormat === after.objectFormat);

mutations.name: PS-late-result-written
mutations.what: the result of a call end() gave up on is written after task_end

mutations.name: PS-end-no-wait
mutations.what: end() does not wait for a call that is still running

mutations.name: PS-end-unfinished-unrecorded
mutations.what: a call that outlasts the wait is not recorded

mutations.name: PS-end-keeps-task
mutations.what: the run stays active after its end

mutations.name: PS-end-status
mutations.what: task_end always says completed

mutations.name: PS-end-halted-ignored

mutations.name: PS-inside-allowed

mutations.name: PS-inside-by-path-only
mutations.what: a data folder that is inside the workspace only on disk (a junction) is not refused

mutations.name: PS-no-secrets
mutations.what: the ledger of a task is not given the registered secrets

mutations.name: PM-no-begin
mutations.what: createAgentSession does not begin the run in the ledger

mutations.name: PM-no-before
mutations.what: the guard records no call

patches.old: const proof = await this.#proofBefore(name, decision, binding, toolUseId, options.signal);

mutations.name: PM-onproof-not-awaited
mutations.what: the guard does not wait for onProof

mutations.name: PM-onproof-throws-out
mutations.what: an onProof that throws makes the call throw

patches.old: catch (error) { this.log(`Sổ bằng chứng: bên gọi không lưu được bằng chứng của ${info.tool} (${error?.message ?? error}).`); }

mutations.name: PM-outcome-always-ok
mutations.what: a call that reported an error is recorded as ok

patches.old: const proofInfo = await this.#proofAfter(proof, result?.isError === true ? 'error' : 'ok', onProof);

mutations.name: PM-threw-unrecorded

mutations.name: PM-finish-nothing

mutations.name: PM-no-options

mutations.what: the proof line does not name the model's call

mutations.name: PA-no-recovery-on-load

mutations.name: PB-no-final-snapshot

mutations.name: PC-child-without-options
mutations.what: a side chat's manager is not given the Hub's proof options

mutations.name: PS-inside-dotdot-prefix

mutations.name: PS-name-cut-at-200
